responsibility: Declares the statement-level Rust AST resolver and inlines most of its logic. ResolveStmt resolves expression statements, let bindings, item statements such as local functions, constants, structs, enums, unions, and extern blocks, creates canonical paths for locally declared items and enum variants, inserts those declarations into the appropriate scopes, and invokes the type, expression, and pattern resolvers for nested contents while preserving the current item and enum prefixes.
same_name_distinction: Holds almost all of ResolveStmt itself as inline visitor definitions for local statements and item statements, including let bindings, local item declarations, enum variants, and function bodies. Unlike the matching .cc file, this header is where the bulk of statement-resolution behavior lives, while the .cc only covers extern-block specifics.
